scope: Endpoint-level joins for the 77 existing treatment assessments. All 21 multi-HPO records and the STRIVE and two sepofarsen study results have manually reviewed trial/result scope. Other single-HPO records retain their cited adjudication and explicitly mark unrecorded analysis details pending detailed scope review. Five structured cellular examples distinguish experimental and clinical scope. No universal allele-to-phenotype mapping, cell causality or treatment suitability is inferred.
